title: I made Seva Jump with AI help. Would love for you to try it!
author: Any-Annual-2848
selftext:
Seva Jump is a pixel-art jumping game inspired by Sikhi and made for everyone. Jump between platforms, dodge birds and try four different modes. It’s free, works offline, and has no ads or purchases.



I used AI to help with coding and pixel art. I built the browser version first, then packaged it for Android, testing and refining the controls and phone/tablet layouts along the way.



Try Seva Jump on Google Play:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.sevajump.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.sevajump.game)



Would love to hear what you think, especially how the controls feel!
